notes.title: Update 4 for 3.0.5.0
notes.content:
We are excited to announce a new update for Spirit of the Island on Android and iOS! This update includes several bug fixes, optimizations, and new features to enhance your gaming experience. Check out the details below:

Android:

 Fixed Korean localization issues (quest items for the Fix Lighthouse quest are now correctly translated).
 Resolved the Treasure Map bug. Now it works correctly: drag the map icon to the USE slot in the inventory menu and open the Island map see a cross marking the treasure location. Dig three times at the marked spot, which may be hidden under a rock.
 Co-op mode optimization and improvements, including a fix for the bridge quest bug.
 Save system improvements.
 

iOS:

 Includes all Android fixes plus:
 Improved stability and crash performance.
 Added ability to move chests and other plants.
 Resolved gamepad disconnection issues.
 Fixed gamepad icons and prompts.
 Enhanced save system.
 Various minor bug fixes and improvements.
 Art optimization for better performance.
 Optimized battery usage.
 Added marriage feature.
 Improved moped and other vehicle controls.
 Added a button to dismount from bikes, etc.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new update and happy adventuring on your island! 🌟

notes.title: Update 3.0.5.0 - Merging the Legacy and Beach Resort Versions!
notes.content:
Hello!

We are excited to present a new update for Spirit of the Island, where we finally can ditch the legacy version and have a unified experience between all platforms: PC, Console and upcoming Mobile! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/724c7d047e0803f9188af15180f3efb86377c827.jpg

We will present patchnotes for both PC and Console versions, respectively. 

PC:
- Fixed various errors in coop mode;
- By merging the version, we've reduced the size of the game by half! Meaning that the install size will be ~3GB.
- Fixed various problems with controllers;
- Fixed an old bug with marriage;
- We've added drag and drop system for PC version! Now you can manage your inventories more conveniently;
- We've also optimised the game to load faster;
- We've changed the Host-Second player interaction the New Story coop mode: now, only the host can finish the active quests. Second player can still interact with all NPCs and do everything else. This was done to ensure maximum compatibility and stability of the gameplay in New Story. 
- Fixed rare issue, when achievements didn't unlock for some players;
- Fixed a very rare issue, when host's and second players save files were swapped.

More fixes for PC version will come soon after the Mobile release, probably in about two weeks from the date.

PC and Console versions are now exactly the same, so there is no launch option for a legacy one now. You just need to launch the game, select region and play!

Consoles:
- Added the new story
- This update also adds Adventureland and Beach Resort DLCs with all of their content for free!
- All above fixes for achievements, controllers and other issues.

As a reminder: you can opt for the launch of SOTI on mobile stores! Here are the links:
Android
iOS

Thank you for supporting us!

notes.title: About the Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hi!

We are a bit delayed on the new console update, because we are still working on bugfixes, especially the new ones that were discovered on PC. Basically, we want to release a more polished product. Please expect news on it next week, when we will know the final release date of the console cross-platform update.

Thank you!

notes.content:
Hello!

We included Beach Resort DLC in the main game package and will remove the DLC page from Steam. The reason is simple: the content is free anyway and having it separate just confuses our players. So we decided to just enable it by default for everyone. It's a cosmetic change so don't worry, nothing will happen in your games. 

Also we are quite pleased to announce that the console update, which will include all new features and both DLCs will be sent to the certification process today. After it's checked by all console platforms, we will release the update and merge crossplay with the new version of the game. Meaning no more launch options and one default version of the game with a full feature set for everyone. As the price of the game is higher on consoles, Adventureland will be included as a free update. We hope to release the update this month, but now the wait process entirely depends on console platforms. 

Thank you for playing Spirit of the Island and have a nice day!

notes.title: Update 3.0.4.0
notes.content:
Hi! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/c991cca2671ae6ad6b33739afb7a93140e20cdb7.jpg

We have another small bugfix update ready:
- We have resolved the large savefile problem - this time completely. There's only one thing: you would need to delete two large txt files in your savegame folder. Sadly, you will lose all of your quest progress - we found no way to avoid this - but all your other progress, including buildings, items, relationships, etc. will remain intact. IMPORTANT: only people that have encountered this issue have to do it! Please do not delete anything if your game works fine!

How to delete the files:
* Press Windows key + R
* Input %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/1M Bits Horde
* Find two largest txt files - they are usually close to or well over 200MB in size
* Delete them

We are very sorry for the inconveniences caused by this. We tried to avoid this, but without the deletion we can't update your savefile system.

- We fixed Key of Elements progression;
- Some small fixes in all quests;
- Fixed the quest sync in coop: now both players should see the correct quest progress.

We are still working on the fixes for the dialogue problem, an update will come soon.

Thank you for playing Spirit of the Island!

notes.title: Update 3.0.3.0
An update 3.0.2.5 is live
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

We are happy to present you with an update 3.0.2.5. We were in a hurry to fix the most annoying issues that some of you have:

Fixed:
- The quest trigger for the Lighthouse quest (if players save the game and quit before entering Lighthouse right and giving items to Tony the quest doesn’t trigger anymore).
- Dialogues with the NPCs in the village do not reset after the load anymore.
- Family Heart quest dialogue fixed.
- Missing names in the dialogues with the Lighthouse, Pirate, and Elisa.
- Huge saves were created when finishing the quest for Hawk.
- Fixed the fire at the old farm hose.
- Issues with the multiplayer when players have a de-sync and were not able to complete the quests together.

Improvements:
-	Players will now get less tired during the day and will have at least 18 hours per day without falling asleep.

One but important note for the ones that experienced issues with the huge save (game save and load time is big or even crash the game): please, go to %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/1M Bits Horde/SOTI, find the huge TXT files (400 MB+) and simply remove these TXT files only!!! Unfortunately, your quests progression will be lost, but all the items, skills, buildings, etc. progress is safe so you don’t need to get new relations, or start everything from scratch, just the questline.

Hope you will like the update.

notes.title: AN update 3.0.2.3 is ready.
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

Some of you have experienced issues with the old save files that were not showing. We have prepared an update that solves this issue and we are happy to present this update.

What was fixed:

1)	Quests that were not saved after you quit the game and load again.
2)	The starting point after you complete the intro quest. Now you will appear near your house instead of the beach house.
3)	Dialogs that were resetting.
4)	Quest triggers in both the multiplayer and the single player.

Hope that these changes will help solve your first problems. The main thing we want to highlight: your old saves didn’t disappear: they are there safe and you didn’t lose any progress. Now you could continue your old game save if you wish to.

We will continue working on the QoLs that were marked.

See you in the Spirit of the Island.

notes.title: New Story Update is Live!
notes.content:
We are very excited to launch the New Story Update! To celebrate the occasion, Spirit of the Island will have a 65% discount for the base game and 20% discount for the Adventureland DLC until February 20th! The discount will launch in 1 hour!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/662b5de2b5871fe9f1d51c8e9be3c416c6d0c519.jpg

New Story mode brings completely reworked quests, dialogues and main story line for both single player and co-op modes. And yes, the story is now the same in both modes. That’s about 25 hours of brand new gameplay completely for free! It’s a great way to experience the game anew. We had a lot of feedback from our dear community  and we did our absolute best to rework everything from scratch. We don’t want to spoil too much here, but we hope that you and your friends are excited to visit our tropical paradise again in both single player and co-op! Oh, and don’t worry about the old story: it will be available as well! If you want to try it, select “Children of the Ocean” when you start the game. But we highly recommend playing the new one first, as it will be the most complete experience you could get!

We are also releasing steam trading cards! Everyone who already played the game will get their drops very quickly after some gameplay. We made emojis, backgrounds and other cool goodies for you to decorate your steam profile!

And for our achievement hunters: we’ve fixed all achievements! You should be able to get 100% without a problem now — sorry for the long wait!

And to add ever more spice to the news: sometime in April, the mobile version of Spirit of the Island will be released for iOS and Android — and it will support crossplay with PC and Consoles! You will be able to play SOTI anywhere you’d like, at home or on the go. And in early summer, we will release a new story and all updated stuff for consoles, finally merging the two versions together. Please wait for the news about both releases!

We’d like to say a huge thanks to our community for supporting us for such a long time. We are preparing a lot of exciting things and new games, so we hope you stick with us for the new releases!

Yours dearly,

1M Bits Horde and Meta Publishing.

notes.title: An Announcement Regarding New Story Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We have a very important announcement to make today: the New Story Update will be delayed. We don’t have a date yet, but we are hoping to release it this month. 

The reason for the delay is the complexity of the update. To make sure everything works smoothly, we created a completely new quest system from scratch. The one that we’ve used before didn’t allow us to make big changes to quest generation, rewards, and quest complexity. That’s why a decision to make a totally new system was made. We were positive that it would be ready in November, but testing showed us that there are still quite a few things to polish before we can release it to you, our players. 

We are going to launch a public test update as soon as we have a build. You will be able to try the new update before release and help us hunt bugs in public testing because we can’t catch everything with our internal QA, it’s simply not possible for a game of this calibre. We will put out an announcement a few days prior to the release of the public test. The test will be completely optional, so if you want to only play the full experience, you can skip it and wait for the full release, which will come after we fix everything that will be reported to us.

We know that the delay is not ideal, but we don’t want to release a buggy update with the potential to break everyone’s old and new save games. No one wants that. We hope you understand our concerns and reasons for this drastic measure. In return, we can promise that the wait is worth it and the game will see major improvements to its story and questing parts — in both single-player and coop modes.

If you have any questions, you can ask us in the comments for the news, or in our Discord server. 

Thank you for always supporting us,

The teams at Meta Publishing and 1M Bits Horde.

Hello!

The next chapter in the Spirit of the Island adventure is about to begin. Console versions of the game with a full Cross-Play support will be available today at 15:00 UTC/08:00AM PST.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/71639c0ac85c2d5e0a6dfad3c73fb5617836c62f.png

Links to the stores:

Playstation
Nintendo Switch

A small reminder about Cross-Play and how it works

With Cross-Play, you will be able to play the coop mode of Spirit of the Island with all your friends, regardless of the platform (PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch). You don't need to do anything special to enable this mode on consoles, but on PC there are some steps that need to be done before you can play with consoles. 

Please note that this is temporary until console edition gets all updates.
1. Right click on Spirit of the Island in your Steam library. 
 - If you are playing on GOG, then go to game settings and untick "DLC"
 - For EGS, you just need to launch basic Spirit of the Island game in your library. 
2. Go to "Properties"
3. Go to "DLC" section.
4. Disable all DLCs. 
5. Launch your game.
6. Before starting a new save, make sure to untick "use DLC save" checkbox. 
7. Proceed to play!

Why you can't use DLCs for now? 
To release console version faster, we had to exclude DLCs and other updates. Please rest assured that all content will arrive not long after the release, together with the new story. Adventureland will arrive as a separate paid DLC, just like on PC. 

We hope you enjoy the console version of the game!

notes.title: Adventurland DLC is LIVE! + Patchnotes for Beach Resort
Adventureland DLC, New Story, and Quality of Life Changes Release Dates
Adventureland is Coming Soon, Console Roadmap, New Story and Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We are excited to reveal the store page for the upcoming DLC — Adventureland!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507940/Spirit_of_the_Island__Adventureland

Turn your Island into a luxurious resort with its own Amusement Park! With the new DLC, you can create 8 new amusements and monetize your land even further. Decorate your park and invite all your visitors for an exciting ride. Wishlist and learn more about the DLC by following the link above. 

To answer some of the questions regarding the DLC:

 You don't need a new save game to play. Everything will work as is; In multiplayer, if the host owns the DLC, the other player will also be able to create all new buildings and try the new mechanics. For a single player, you need your own personal copy. 
 Adventureland will open brand new horizons and further expand on the sandbox experience that Spirit of the Island provides to you. We hope you are excited for it!

The second cool news is the console release roadmap of Spirit of the Island.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/844ef9556edd56bc8af10dc2ee40f0b04273b6d3.jpg

Spirit of the Island will feature full cross-play between all platforms, be it Xbox, PC, Switch, or PlayStation. So don’t worry about being separated from your friends on different platforms, because now you can start the multiplayer adventure on PC with your friend joining from their preferred console of choice. Important: save game files can’t be used in-between different platforms. For example, if your save game was created on PC, you can’t move it to the console (the file itself). 

Around the same time as the console version goes out, the new storyline will be ready for Spirit of the Island. It will feature a completely rewritten story which will be available in both multiplayer and single-player. We are currently working on translations and new gameplay mechanics for the new story. 

With the release of the new storyline, Spirit of the Island will be feature complete. What does that mean for the game? All new updates that come out will be focused on bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements only. Our development team is currently working on a new project which we can’t talk about yet, but it’s going to be an exciting game for sure. Of course, we will remain active on Discord and Steam to read all your questions and potential ideas — don’t worry, these won’t go to waste and they will be used in the future *wink*. We’ll have another announcement about it later in the future. 

Last, but certainly not least — Steam Trading Cards! Yes, that’s right, SOTI is finally getting them and we are currently hands full creating the emojis, backgrounds, and the cards themselves. We know that everyone in the community wanted them for a long time and they will finally become a reality!

Don’t forget to wishlist Adventureland and have fun on the island!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/fa25273c31aea44257849c4624ade432c8b482e7.png

notes.title: Spirit of the Island Store Price Update
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

We are excited to announce that we will be reducing store prices for Spirit of the Island, This reduction will be permanent, New baseline price will be 17.99USD/17.49EUR. For other regions - please check your store page to see the updated price.

We bet that you all have a question - why? There are two main reasons for this big change: 

1. Some game developers tend to increase their prices to counter inflation and other economic factors nowadays. We have decided to do the opposite and instead make Spirit of the Island more affordable for the players. We sincerely think that we'd be better off by having a more active and alive community, than by making a few more $.

2. As many of you know, console version with crossplay is coming later this year (Q4 2023), with mobile version to follow later on in the future. This is also the reason why we want to SOTI to be a more affordable game for everyone. Won't it be fun to play with all your friends no matter the platform of choice?

We hope that you are excited by these news. Stay tuned for the updates: we are working hard on the new storyline (adding it into the game and making various cool changes to make it even more fun) and our upcoming DLC.

Have a nice day!

notes.content:
Today META Publishing celebrates its birthday! And in order to share the holiday mood we prepared a lot of gifts for you! Follow us on Twitter and retweet the post to participate in the giveaway for META Publishing games keys. 

Next week we will pick 10 winners and each winner will receive a key to every META Publishing game:


 Spirit of the Island 

Spirit of the Island is a relaxing life simulation RPG set on a tropical island. Explore the once-prosperous tourist destination in co-op with your friend, meet the locals, and lend a hand to restore the town to their former glory as you embark on a long journey that will help you rediscover your past!
You can expect a cross platform release soon! Versions for XBOX and PS are almost ready and the mobile version is under active development.

An epic RPG with a profound narrative and challenging game play. Join the crusade, choose your mythical path and defeat the demons.

Biped is a co-op action adventure game with a strong focus on moment-to-moment collaboration between 2 players.
Biped 2 is already in development and will be out soon!


 Train Valley and Train Valley 2

Train Valley is a puzzle-strategy train simulator video game. Build railways, manage traffic and stay accident-free. Complete the story mode from the Gold Rush of 1849 to the first manned spaceflight, and then explore the random mode.


 Time Loader

Time Loader is a story-driven, physics-based puzzle platformer with a twist. At the helm of a small robot, you'll travel back to the 90s to prevent a tragic accident. Explore the house of your creator, solve brain-teasing puzzles, acquire unique and powerful upgrades, and see common household items from an entirely new perspective!


 HordeCore

HordeCore is a kick-ass action side-scroller set in a post-apocalyptic world. Become the leader of an ever-expanding group of survivors. Manage supplies, upgrade your team, and craft deadly contraptions to defend yourself!


 The Uncertain: Light at the End

The Uncertain is a story-driven adventure game in a post-apocalyptic world. Humanity disappeared from the face of the Earth and has been replaced by robots.

notes.content:
Hello!

Part 2 of our Halloween update is live! This update is focused on some of the most requested community features, so we bet you'll love it.

New feature: re-base your house. That's right, you can change the location of your home freely now! We hope it opens up even more space for creativity;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/e5a998b0e9053830ddc67cf335032cea2754d7ea.png

New building: Greenhouse. So Winter was a sad season for farming, right? Now you can build a greenhouse and enjoy fresh fruits and veggies all year round!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/fc6f3fdbd3e2090605b205f443e5ea4253a4ea6f.png

Update 1.0.4.0
The updated roadmap
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Today we  are presenting the updated roadmap for Spirit of the Island. We've had a big and long look at all of your feedback about the game and after some discussions decided on a most realistic roadmap for the present year. Please do note, that this is only about new features and improvements, regular bug fixes will continue as usual. 

Now, to outline some things: 
- In September we plan to vastly improve things that everyone is asking for, mainly inventory and the map of the game. We'll bring drag and drop, better handling with the controller, map will have new visuals and pointers and so on. It should be a very good. improvement. 
- For October, we'll be working on Greenhouse - a brand new building that will act like a house for your plants at Winter. It will have upgrades, several floors and lots of space to plant and decorate. Since it will be movable, we'll also add that option to your house. 
- November might look kinda "meh", but trust us, it's a big and complex system and requires a lot of work. We'd like to even have multiplayer marriages between players as well and this will need a lot of testing and development time. 
- And finally, December. We plan to add Pets and Banking this month, which will add another level of depth to the game. 

We hope the new updates will bring you joy and fun. Please continue to leave reviews and contact us on Steam and the Discord server with your suggestions and feedback. 
Thank you for your support, and we wish you an enjoyable time at our Tropical Paradise! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/35d27083f10e45e0c06d383a1e7bd4e3794a9586.png

notes.content:
Hello friends!

Today we would like to talk about the release and our future plans.

We held a Kickstarter campaign with a certain road map and a set content plan. We’ve had a promise to our backers to release everything originally planned this Summer and we did exactly so, with all originally planned content.

So why did we have early access in the first place? It was done to have an opportunity to work on the game with our community. A lot of changes and fixes we made during the early access are based on your help and feedback. And we are really grateful for that.

What about QoL and future updates? We are going to release a new patch tomorrow with new improvements and fixes. You can find a list of changes below. Also we are going to add inventory UI and few more QoL improvements next week. And we want to add drag & drop as soon as possible. 

We will present an updated roadmap next week. We already have tons of ideas, but we're looking closely at your feedback now and we are ready to add new QoL features there. Please treat 1.0 as a feature complete milestone. It’s the game with everything originally planned plus more from your feedback. And we won’t stop here. 

The work on the project WILL NOT stop anytime soon! Moreover, we will continue to support the game in 2023. We are working on porting the game to consoles already and we will start porting the game to mobile next year. We have promised and we'll have full cross-platform co-op between ALL platforms, including mobile. Isn’t it fun? 

Thank you so much for the feedback. We understand your concerns and are already working on improvements and fixes.

# Changes

- Changed the resolution support: players can have free resizable window. It should work with ultra wide;
Add FOV camera option
Add right mouse change camera angle (X)
Camera angle will change based on terrain detection 

# Fixes

- Fixed issue with characters loading with the wrong skin colour;

notes.title: Update v0.17.5
Spirit of the Island - Update 0.17.4
Important Announcement Regarding Online Play in China!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

We have received many reports about problems with coop play in China. We are deeply sorry about this, and the fix is on the way; it will take us a few days to get it ready. 

The Problem
We are using Amazon servers to sync the data between players and the server, but they are getting blocked in China. We never knew this would happen and are making an alternative solution for our Chinese players right at this moment. 

There are two workarounds:

1. You can try using VPN - this should solve all issues with online play. While it's a less than optimal experience, it should make your game work fine while we are preparing the update. 
2. While not a fix, you can always try our single-player campaign while you wait. It has more quests and the first part of the story, which is fun and should keep you occupied for a few days. 

Again, we are deeply sorry about the issues. We are doing our best to fix everything ASAP. 

Thank you for supporting Spirit of the Island!

notes.title: A Preview of Today's Update!
Release Date Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello friends! How’s it going?

The big day is finally here! We are proud to announce that we are ready to reveal the release date of Early Access!

As we’ve announced before, we decided to postpone the Early Access release to ensure the best possible launch for everyone, and that commitment still stands. Now we are in a place where we can guarantee the best possible experience for everyone - from our dear Backers to all the new players.  So mark the date in your calendars, folks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/54ab042c340bf0df1ce84e776e51e91d332de215.jpg
 
We’ve prepared many fun activities for the Early Access launch too! A little teaser: we’ll be having a fun contest with very nice prizes, so hone your creative skills. But that’s all we can say right now!

New Features Awaiting You in Early Access
While we did move the release further into the future, the work has never ceased, and Spirit of the Island is looking better than ever. Since November, we’ve been running a special Backer Access version for our Kickstarter backers. And it’s going on incredibly well! Our amazing backers gave us lots of valuable feedback. We’ve already implemented many things that otherwise wouldn’t be in the Early Access day one. To list some examples:


 Repair function — now you can use your hammer to fix other tools (not another hammer, though!) at the expense of the hammer’s durability;
 Toggling “Item Drag” in the settings — sometimes you don’t need a magnet for dropped items so that it can be safely disabled now;
 Improved water — it looks better than ever now;
 Added key bindings, one of the most requested features;
 Two new Islands for you to explore!

And lots of other stuff! We dive deeper into our latest additions in the development blog, which we released a few weeks before. If you missed it - here it is!

[previewyoutube=ZHysTJ-KhI4;full][/previewyoutube]
 
And we aren’t stopping here! Spirit of the Island is all about community-driven development so expect even more feedback-based changes and improvements when we go into Early Access!

We are super excited and can't wait to launch Spirit of the Island officially! Nothing of this would have been possible without the help and support of our dear Backers and the amazing community. To everyone - HUGE thanks!

We'll see you in March!

notes.title: Ask Us Anything!
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers! We are happy to officially open the Steam page for Spirit of the Island! 

Of course the most observant of you have noticed that it has been public for some time now - thank you for keeping it secret!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/4e5f8b88dc220cb714aea2b5f1dd3b4be6d15899.gif

To celebrate the occasion, we’ve prepared a short blog with some facts about the game! Please enjoy and feel free to ask any kinds of questions!

 SOTI will have about 14 explorable islands! The number is not final, but this is our goal at this moment!
 The pirates are your main enemies in the game! Beware of them while exploring different islands and try to not bring too many things with you - they’ll surely try to take them away!
 The game will have 4 different seasons, just like in real life: Summer, Autumn, Spring, and Winter. They’ll also affect pretty much everything around you, be it animals or plants!
 Speaking about animals, you’ll be able to adopt cats and dogs!
 The game will have explorable caves with lots of useful loot! But people say that ferocious Cave Worms also inhabit these and will attack anyone, who disturbs them. Will you take that risk?
 Last, but not least: NPCs. The game will feature a relationship system between you and other characters. Being on their good side will be very beneficial for you so we suggest befriending them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/8248723687c30356c4f50c0537ea9b35cc0519a0.gif

Feel free to ask us any questions in the comments and we’ll try our best to give you the best reply we can! More information to come soon, so stay tuned for our news!

Don’t forget to wishlist the game and see you around!
